question: Two Tit for Tats mishear one move. How much long-run score survives?
answer: About one-third of the long-run score survives. One misread friendly move starts a back-and-forth of hits, since each copies the other's last move. A second misread locks both into defecting for good.
move: Copying every move turns one mistake into an endless echo.
